title: Preparation of cultured cells for scanning electron microscope
protocol: Pre-warm fixative solution to 37 degrees C.
Remove media from plastic tissue culture dish and rapidly pour on glutaraldehyde fixative.
Rinse with buffer or PBS three times over 5 minutes.
Rinse with buffer five times over 10 minutes.
Incubate in freshly made 1% carbohydrazide 10-30 minutes.
Rinse with distilled water five times over 15 minutes.
Rinse three times with distilled water over 15 minutes. In the third rinse, cut dishes to fit the critical point dryer.
Dehydrate through ethanol or hexylene glycol series beginning with 30%, changing to solutions of 50%, 70%, 90%, and three times 100% over 30 minutes.
